upstreams.what: The site theme, fetched by jekyll-remote-theme at the tag `_config.yml` pins; our differences are overlays Jekyll layers over the theme: `assets/css/style.scss` (stock import, then the site's own components), `_includes/head-custom.html` (stock analytics include, the feed link and hreflang alternates for the translations) and `_layouts/article.html` (built on the stock `default` layout). Deleting them leaves the stock theme working.
upstreams.review: Read the release notes and the diff of `_layouts/default.html`, `_includes/head-custom.html`, `assets/css/style.scss` and `_sass/variables.scss` between the pin and the new tag; bump `remote_theme` in `_config.yml`, recheck each overlay against the new stock file (the variables style.scss uses must still exist), run the validators (the Docker build), then --mark with the new tag.

upstreams.what: The Jekyll build image (github-pages gem 232) and the plugin versions it ships: jekyll-remote-theme, jekyll-seo-tag, jekyll-feed, jekyll-sitemap, jekyll-redirect-from, all used at stock defaults from `_config.yml`. Dependabot bumps the workflow's SHA pin; `tools/jekyll_build.sh` follows it.
upstreams.review: Read the release notes and the github-pages gem's dependency versions for the five plugins; check the seo tags, feed.xml, sitemap.xml and the `/posts/*.html` redirect pages in the Docker build output, then --mark with the new tag (Dependabot's pull request carries the pin).

upstreams.what: `.github/workflows/jekyll-gh-pages.yml`, copied from the GitHub Pages Jekyll starter workflow; our differences are SHA-pinned actions with version comments and least-privilege job permissions.
upstreams.review: Diff the starter workflow between the pin and the new commit; copy in changed steps, triggers or permissions while keeping the SHA pins and least-privilege tokens, run the validators, then --mark with the new commit.

upstreams.what: YAML reading of the posts' front matter in `tools/health_check.py`, at the pin `tools/requirements.txt` sets (the same as agent-core's); replaces a hand-written front-matter parser.
upstreams.review: Read the changelog between the pin and the new tag; bump `tools/requirements.txt` together with agent-core's pin, run the validators, then --mark with the new tag.

upstreams.what: Link, image and script checks of the built site, run at stock defaults (external links off) by `tools/jekyll_build.sh` inside the jekyll-build-pages image; it verifies the translation pills and hreflang URLs the posts declare, which `tools/health_check.py` no longer derives from a reimplementation of Jekyll permalinks.
upstreams.review: Read the release notes between the pin and the new release (changed defaults, CLI flags such as --swap-urls); bump `proofer=` in `tools/jekyll_build.sh`, run the validators (the Docker build), then --mark with the new tag.
